title: AS2: try/catch/finally
description: Implement try/catch/finally in the AS2 compiler (packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts). AVM1 uses ActionTry (0x8F) which has: catchInRegister flag, catchTarget (register # or variable name), tryBody, catchBody, finallyBody — all backpatched sizes. Read packages/core/src/as2/compiler.ts to see if ActionTry is handled. If not, implement compileTryCatchStmt: emit ActionTry header, compile tryBody, compile catchBody (bind error to catch var), compile finallyBody. Add tests.
